author: QA (AI-assisted)

story.title: As a registered user, I want to reset my password via an emailed link so I can regain access to my account

scope_summary: Covers the self-service 'Forgot password' flow on the web login page: requesting a reset link, link validity (single use, 30-minute expiry), new-password rules (8–64 chars, at least one digit and one letter) and the post-reset login. Main risks: account takeover through link reuse or user enumeration, and users being locked out by unclear validation.
out_of_scope: Email template visual design (owned by Marketing)

requirements.text: A user can request a reset link from the login page by entering their email address.
The same neutral confirmation message is shown whether or not the email is registered.
The reset link expires 30 minutes after it is issued.
The new password must be 8–64 characters and contain at least one letter and one digit.
A reset link can be used only once.
After a successful reset the old password no longer works and the new one does.

assumptions: The confirmation message text is 'If an account exists for that email, we've sent a reset link.' (not specified in the story; taken from the UX mock referenced in the comments).
IMP-1: the old password is invalidated immediately on reset (standard behaviour; not stated explicitly).
The test environment uses a mail catcher (e.g. MailHog) where emails can be read.
open_questions: Should existing sessions on other devices be signed out after a reset? This affects whether a security test for session invalidation is needed.
Is there a rate limit on reset requests per email or IP? If so, what is the threshold?
Does requesting a second link invalidate the first one?

test_cases.title: Verify registered user can reset password via emailed link and sign in
test_cases.objective: Confirm the main success scenario end to end: request, email, reset, login with the new password.
preconditions: Mail catcher inbox for <registered_user_email> is empty.

steps.action: Open the login page and click **Forgot password?**
steps.expected: The **Reset your password** page is displayed with an **Email** field and a **Send reset link** button.

steps.action: Enter <registered_user_email> in **Email** and click **Send reset link**.
steps.expected: The message 'If an account exists for that email, we've sent a reset link.' is displayed.

steps.action: Open the mail catcher and open the newest email to <registered_user_email>.
steps.expected: One email with subject containing 'Reset your password' is present and contains a reset link.
The **Choose a new password** page opens with **New password** and **Confirm password** fields.

steps.action: Enter 'NewPass2026' in both fields and click **Reset password**.
steps.expected: The message 'Your password has been reset.' is shown and the user is redirected to the login page.
Sign-in succeeds and the account dashboard is displayed.

postconditions: Reset the account password back to 'OldPass123' for subsequent runs.

test_cases.title: Verify old password is rejected after a successful reset
test_cases.objective: Ensure the previous credential is invalidated so a leaked old password cannot be used.
preconditions: Password for <registered_user_email> was just reset from 'OldPass123' to 'NewPass2026' (e.g. by executing TC-1001-001 steps 1–5).

steps.action: On the login page, enter <registered_user_email> and 'OldPass123', then click **Sign in**.
steps.expected: Sign-in is refused with the message 'Incorrect email or password.' and the user stays on the login page.

test_cases.title: Display neutral confirmation for an unregistered email without sending mail
test_cases.objective: Prevent user enumeration: an unknown email must produce the same message and no email.

steps.action: Open **Forgot password?**, enter 'nobody.qa+1001@example.com' and click **Send reset link**.
steps.expected: The message 'If an account exists for that email, we've sent a reset link.' is displayed — identical to the registered-email case.

steps.action: Check the mail catcher for 'nobody.qa+1001@example.com' after 2 minutes.
steps.expected: No email has been delivered to that address.

test_cases.title: Reject reset link used after 30-minute expiry
test_cases.objective: Verify the link expiry boundary (just outside 30 minutes).
preconditions: A reset link was requested for <registered_user_email> at time T and has not been used.
Tester can wait, or ask Dev to shorten the clock in the test environment.

steps.action: At T + 30 minutes 30 seconds, open the reset link.
steps.expected: The page shows 'This reset link has expired. Please request a new one.' and no password fields are displayed.

test_cases.title: Allow reset link used just before 30-minute expiry
test_cases.objective: Verify the link expiry boundary (just inside 30 minutes).
preconditions: A reset link was requested for <registered_user_email> at time T and has not been used.

steps.action: At T + 29 minutes 30 seconds, open the reset link.
steps.expected: The **Choose a new password** page opens with password fields enabled.

test_cases.title: Reject new password outside 8–64 character length limits
test_cases.objective: Verify length boundaries of the password rule: 7 and 65 rejected, 8 and 64 accepted.
preconditions: Tester is on the **Choose a new password** page via a valid, unused reset link.

steps.action: Enter 'Abcde12' (7 chars) in both fields and click **Reset password**.
steps.expected: Error 'Password must be 8–64 characters.' is shown under **New password**; the page does not submit.

steps.action: Enter the 65-character value in both fields and click **Reset password**.
steps.expected: Error 'Password must be 8–64 characters.' is shown; the page does not submit.

steps.action: Enter the 64-character value in both fields.
Replace with 'Abcdef12' (8 chars) in both fields and click **Reset password**.
steps.expected: The message 'Your password has been reset.' is shown.

postconditions: Reset the account password back to 'OldPass123'.

test_cases.title: Reject new password without a digit or without a letter
test_cases.objective: Verify each invalid composition class of the password rule separately.
preconditions: Tester is on the **Choose a new password** page via a valid, unused reset link.

steps.action: Enter 'abcdefgh' in both fields and click **Reset password**.
steps.expected: Error 'Password must contain at least one letter and one digit.' is shown; the page does not submit.

steps.action: Enter '12345678' in both fields and click **Reset password**.
steps.expected: Error 'Password must contain at least one letter and one digit.' is shown; the page does not submit.

test_cases.title: Prevent reuse of a reset link that was already used
test_cases.objective: Ensure a reset link is single-use so an intercepted link cannot be replayed.
preconditions: A reset link for <registered_user_email> has just been used successfully to set a new password.

steps.action: Open the same reset link again in a new browser tab.
steps.expected: The page shows 'This reset link is no longer valid. Please request a new one.' and no password fields are displayed.

postconditions: Reset the account password back to 'OldPass123'.
